context: A bound method with validation and errors

checklist.name: value_error_return
checklist.description: The bound method returns (Profile, error) or (*Profile, error), so a validation failure rejects the frontend promise.

checklist.name: json_tags
checklist.description: The request and result structs give every field an explicit json tag.

checklist.name: go_side_validation
checklist.description: Validates length, uniqueness, and the ID in Go, not only in the frontend.

checklist.name: no_exported_helpers
checklist.description: Validation and lookup helpers are unexported functions or methods, because every exported method on the bound struct is callable from JavaScript.

checklist.name: locking
checklist.description: Guards the profile map with a mutex because bound calls can run concurrently.

checklist.name: regenerate_bindings
checklist.description: Says to regenerate the wailsjs bindings (wails dev, wails build, or wails generate module) instead of editing them by hand.

checklist.name: frontend_reject
checklist.description: The TypeScript caller catches the rejected promise, shows the error text, and reports success only after the call resolves.
